brief: Keep it under 40 seconds and upbeat. Open on the intro where I say who I am, and end on the line about sitting down to record. End card that says "Caleb Schalesky" with "AI systems for small business". Two shorts.

cuts.reason: The hook the brief asks for: name plus what I build. Ends just after 'systems' (9.1) and before the 9.88 false start where the line restarts and trails off.
Narrows many systems down to the one that matters and sets up that this video is the proof. Keeps the opening 'I' and lets the 0.33-0.74 pause tighten at render.
Pays off the claim with the concrete mechanic: a few phone clips in, one clean video out. Out set a beat after 'video' (7.9).
The closer the brief named: all I had to do was sit down and record. Highest moment score in the inventory, lands straight into the end card.

shorts.reason: Opens cold on the claim and needs nothing from the rest of the cut: phone footage in, professional video out.
Self-contained identity short: name plus the one-line value prop, cut after 'plates' (4.9) so it ends on the benefit rather than the second sentence.

notes: Cuts total 30.45s plus a 3s end card = 33.45s, comfortably under 40 and tighter still once tight pace caps internal pauses at 0.25s. Dropped clip 2 (resume agent, 11.58s) on purpose: it is a complete, clean take but it is a job-search tangent that does not fit the 'AI systems for small business' end card, and including it would push the cut past 40s. Clip 1 is also the only take of the intro, so its false start at 9.88 is trimmed rather than replaced. Kept clip 5 out of the shorts even though it scores highest, since 'the best part is' depends on setup from earlier in the video.
